description: This file defines the 'Gdpr' class within the Opencart Admin Model Customer namespace, containing methods to manage GDPR-related data such as editing status, deleting entries, retrieving GDPR records, and fetching expiration-related information.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A model class that manages GDPR data, including CRUD operations and querying GDPR-related records.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'status' of a GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdpr
methods.description: Deletes a GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: deleteGdprsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all GDPR records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getGdprs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GDPR records, applying optional filters such as email, action, status, and date range.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Fetches a single GDPR record by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getTotalGdprs
methods.description: Returns the total count of GDPR records, optionally filtered by email, action, status, and date range.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves GDPR records that are expired based on the configured limit and status.
